item.title: Krishna Shroff joins reality show ‘The 50’, says she is her “own biggest competitor”
item.description: Speaking ahead of her entry into the show, Krishna said that while she has experience with reality television, The 50 promises to be a completely different challenge. She expressed excitement about interacting with a wide range of personalities under one roof.

item.title: HYDRAA Restores Gachibowli Park, Removes Road Encroachments in Shamirpet
item.description: HYDRAA restores Gachibowli Park and removes illegal road encroachments in Shamirpet, improving public spaces, traffic flow, and urban infrastructure in Hyderabad.

item.title: Karnataka Tourism takes a new step into central India
item.description: After the successful conduct of family tour programmes to Tamil Nadu and Kerala, the Karnataka Tourism Society (KTS) has taken another significant step to expand Karnataka’s tourism presence by reaching out to the Central Indian travel market through a focused B2B Roadshow Series.The roadshow will be held from January 27-31, covering five important cities — Indore (27 Jan), Nagpur (28 Jan), Aurangabad (29 Jan), Nashik (30 Jan), and Pune (31 Jan). item.description: Despite being fully shot, Hum Mein Shahenshah Kaun was never certified for release at the time due to a series of setbacks.

item.title: Kejriwal, Mann roll out free cashless treatment up to Rs 10 lakh
item.description: AAP supremo Arvind Kejriwal and Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann on Thursday rolled out the state government’s ambitious ‘Mukh Mantri Sehat Yojna’ -- which will provide free cashless medical treatment of up to Rs 10 lakh to every family in the state.The universal healthcare cover will be provided to all 65 lakh families in the state.
